website.note: Consumer hemp/CBD retail brand of subsidiary Atlanta CBD; no drug pipeline.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: TCRG is a consumer hemp/CBD retail and health-and-wellness company. Its only operating asset is a 51% interest in Atlanta CBD, Inc., which sells hemp-derived CBD consumer products under the INNO Medicinals brand. The company conducts no FDA-regulated drug development, has no clinical-stage assets, and runs no Phase 1/2/3 trials.
